# FMEApex

> Connected quality engineering: design structure, process risk, control plans, and verified actions.

FMEApex is a digital FMEA workspace. It connects engineering records instead of treating every document as an isolated spreadsheet.
The product story follows structure and functions, failure relationships, linked process controls, and owned actions with evidence.
Design-to-process characteristic flow is distinct from linked PFD, PFMEA, and control-plan relationships. Not every field synchronizes across every document.

## Trial and commercial offers
Explore a reference project without signing up and create one custom project for 24 hours. Team and enterprise offers require a quote for an agreed scope.
See https://fmeapex.online/pricing.md for pricing context.

## Engineering boundaries
Draft analysis is iterative. Completeness is assessed before review or release, while references, permissions, and revision protections remain enforced.
A process flow describes routing; the PFMEA structure tree describes the analysis hierarchy.
Action Priority is calculated from the configured integer S/O/D inputs. Do not interpret AP alone as risk acceptance or task completion as proof of reduced risk.
Exact handbook numerical conformity requires verification against the applicable licensed reference.
Examples on public pages are illustrative and do not change live engineering data.
No certification, guaranteed compliance, audit-pass rate, customer-count, or performance metric is claimed.
